sections.title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 10-18, INCOME
December 27, 2018
sections.content_text:
Manual:
Aged, Blind and Disabled
Change No:
10-18
To:
County Directors of Social Services

sections.title: I. BACKGROUND AND CONTENT OF CHANGE
sections.content_text: The Division of Health Benefits (DHB) has revised and/or updated Medicaid policy to provide clarity and/or correction to policy. The revisions are spelled out in section II below.

sections.title: II. POLICY UPDATE
sections.content_text:
MA-2250, Income
The Income policy has been revised in the online Adult Medicaid Manual:
With the additional procedures for potential Unemployment Insurance Benefit (UIB) claims.
